vocabulary.meaning_en: one suggestion about what to do
vocabulary.note_ar: advice غير معدودة، فلا نقول an advice أو advices
vocabulary.example: Let me give you a piece of advice.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the base form of a verb without "to" (go, talk, seek)
vocabulary.example: After "would" we use the bare infinitive: I would go.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a person who is extremely worried and stressed
vocabulary.example: If you keep worrying, you'll be a nervous wreck.

vocabulary.meaning_en: learn new skills for a different job
vocabulary.example: Have you ever considered retraining as a teacher?

vocabulary.meaning_en: in person, not by phone or message
vocabulary.example: Have you tried discussing it face to face?
Put your head down and study for a few hours.

vocabulary.meaning_en: (informal) do an activity together with a friend
vocabulary.example: Let's buddy up and go to the gym together.

vocabulary.meaning_en: be reasonable or easy to understand
vocabulary.example: That actually makes a lot of sense.

vocabulary.meaning_en: (informal) wait and not decide or act for a while
vocabulary.example: I'll sit on it for a little while before I decide.

vocabulary.meaning_en: do something that is not quite allowed
vocabulary.example: I won't bend the rules, even a little.

vocabulary.meaning_en: bored or annoyed with something that has gone on too long
vocabulary.example: She was fed up with all the advice.

fine_lines.title: Have you ever considered + -ing vs + question word
fine_lines.explanation_ar: بعد consider نستخدم عادة ing، لكن يمكن أن يأتي بعدها سؤال بأداة استفهام مثل what أو how.
fine_lines.explanation_en: After "consider" we usually use -ing, but it can also be followed by a question word like "what" or "how".

examples.sentence: Have you ever considered studying abroad?
Have you considered what your parents will think?

fine_lines.title: Positive vs negative responses to advice
fine_lines.explanation_ar: الرد الإيجابي يعني أنك ستجرّب النصيحة، والرد السلبي يعني أنك تشك فيها أو ترفضها.
fine_lines.explanation_en: A positive response means you will try the advice; a negative one shows doubt or refusal.

examples.sentence: Talk to him directly? OK, it's worth a try.
Just stop worrying? That's easier said than done.

expressions.phrase: If I were in your shoes, I'd ...
expressions.meaning_en: Gives advice by imagining your situation.
expressions.example: If I were in your shoes, I'd ask for help.

expressions.phrase: If I were you, I would ...
expressions.example: If I were you, I would see a doctor today.

expressions.phrase: Have you ever thought of / about ...ing?
expressions.example: Have you ever thought about training to be a nurse?

expressions.phrase: Have you ever considered ...?
expressions.meaning_en: Asks someone to think about an option.
expressions.example: Have you ever considered retraining?

expressions.phrase: If I had that problem, I would ...
expressions.meaning_ar: لو كانت لديّ هذه المشكلة لـ ...
expressions.meaning_en: Advice by saying what you would do.
expressions.example: If I had that problem, I would talk to a friend.

expressions.phrase: Have you ever tried ...ing?
expressions.example: Have you ever tried explaining exactly what you want?

expressions.phrase: How about ...ing?
expressions.example: How about coming to the gym with me next week?

expressions.phrase: Why don't you ...?
expressions.example: Why don't you stop complaining and do something about it?

expressions.phrase: I think it would be a good idea to ...
expressions.example: I think it would be a good idea to call an electrician.

expressions.phrase: The sooner you ..., the better.
expressions.example: The sooner you start studying, the better you'll feel.

expressions.phrase: You have no choice but to ...
expressions.example: You have no choice but to tell your manager.

expressions.phrase: Oh yeah, that's a thought.
expressions.meaning_en: Positive: "Why didn't I think of that?"
expressions.example: Ask my brother to help? Oh yeah, that's a thought.

expressions.phrase: I think I'll take you up on that.
expressions.example: You'll come with me the first time? I think I'll take you up on that.

expressions.phrase: I think I'll give it a go / a try.
expressions.meaning_en: Says you will try the advice.
expressions.example: Running in the mornings? I think I'll give it a go.

expressions.phrase: Nothing ventured, nothing gained.
expressions.meaning_en: You must try to get anything.
expressions.example: Apply anyway. Nothing ventured, nothing gained.

expressions.phrase: I hadn't thought of that. That makes a lot of sense.
expressions.meaning_ar: لم أفكر في ذلك. هذا منطقي جدًا.
expressions.example: Talk to her after the holidays? I hadn't thought of that. That makes a lot of sense.

expressions.phrase: Well, it's worth a try.
expressions.meaning_en: Not sure it will work, but you'll try.
expressions.example: It might not work, but it's worth a try.

expressions.phrase: That's a great idea. I really appreciate your advice.
expressions.example: That's a great idea. I really appreciate your advice.

expressions.phrase: That's easier said than done.
expressions.meaning_en: Negative: the advice is hard to follow.
expressions.example: Talk to my boss? That's easier said than done.

expressions.phrase: That's all very well, but I'm not sure it would work.
expressions.meaning_ar: هذا جميل، لكنني لست متأكدًا أنه سينجح.
expressions.example: That's all very well, but I'm not sure it would work.

expressions.phrase: You have a point, but ...
expressions.example: You have a point, but I'll wait a bit longer.

expressions.phrase: I can see where you're coming from.
expressions.meaning_en: Shows you understand the other person's view.
expressions.example: I can see where you're coming from, but I disagree.

expressions.phrase: I think I'll just sit on it for a while.
expressions.example: Thanks for the advice. I think I'll just sit on it for a while.

expressions.phrase: I prefer to do it my way.
expressions.example: That's an interesting opinion, but I prefer to do it my way.

expressions.phrase: That's not in line with my values.
expressions.example: I won't bend the rules. That's not in line with my values.

expressions.phrase: Thanks, but no thanks.
expressions.example: Work this weekend? Thanks, but no thanks.

grammar.title: Second conditional for advice: If I were you, I would + verb
grammar.explanation_ar: نستخدم If + الماضي (were مع كل الضمائر) ثم would + الفعل الأساسي. If I were you أصح من If I was you في الإنجليزية الرسمية.
grammar.explanation_en: Use If + past ("were" with all subjects), then would + base verb. "If I were you" is more correct than "If I was you" in formal English.
examples: If I were you, I would talk to him.
If I had that problem, I'd ask for help.
If she were in your shoes, she would apply.

grammar.title: Which form comes next? -ing, base verb or to + verb
grammar.explanation_ar: ing بعد: حروف الجر (of, about)، tried، considered، How about. الفعل الأساسي بعد: would، Why don't you. to + الفعل بعد: It would be a good idea، no choice but.
grammar.explanation_en: -ing after prepositions (of, about), "tried", "considered", "How about". Base verb after "would" and "Why don't you". To + verb after "It would be a good idea" and "no choice but".
examples: Have you ever tried talking to her?
Why don't you go home early?
You have no choice but to wait.

questions.question: Which is correct?
choices: She gave me some good advice.
questions.explanation_ar: advice غير معدودة، فنقول some advice.

questions.question: If I ___ in your shoes, I'd apologise.
questions.explanation_ar: في الشرط الثاني نقول If I were.

questions.question: Have you ever tried ___ to her face to face?
If I had that problem, I would ___ a friend.
Which response ACCEPTS the advice?
choices: I think I'll give it a go.
I prefer to do it my way.
questions.explanation_ar: I'll give it a go تعني أنك ستجرّب النصيحة.
questions.explanation_en: "I'll give it a go" accepts the advice.

questions.question: "I can see where you're coming from" means:
choices: I understand your point of view.

questions.question: "Nothing ventured, nothing gained" means:
choices: If you don't try, you can't win anything.
questions.explanation_ar: إذا لم تجرّب فلن تكسب شيئًا.
questions.explanation_en: If you don't try, you can't gain anything.

questions.question: "I'll sit on it for a while" means:
Why don't you ___ for another job?
questions.explanation_ar: بعد Why don't you نستخدم الفعل الأساسي.
questions.explanation_en: After "Why don't you" use the base verb.

questions.question: "That's not in line with my values" is used to:
choices: refuse advice because it feels wrong
questions.explanation_en: It refuses advice that feels morally wrong.
